purpose: Compare three-regime models against the latest team-lead two-stage model, emphasizing zero and extreme-tail diagnostics without changing the overall log-RMSE objective
features: Original sorted fixed reference catalogue; 13 raw + 17 environment + 4 mass features
split: Original stratified 80:20, seed 42; only original training 80% used in this experiment
candidate_definition: True SFR == 0 / 0<SFR<=T / SFR>T. HGB400 multiclass gate and two HGB400 log regressors trained on true regimes. Soft probability mixture in log space. P0>=0.9 forces zero.
candidate_selection: Lowest mean 5-fold overall log RMSE among three candidates; this is exploratory selection on the same CV, not an independent test
secondary_metrics: fixed SFR>10, >30, >100 log RMSE and log bias
promotion: Save best three-regime candidate for use and review; do not overwrite current adopted A or automatically push
holdout: Not evaluated or used for selection in this experiment
